note: Bundled sound library. CC0 packs, plus sounds made for precut. Whooshes, risers and room tone are synthesised or measured by the app (src/main/sfx.ts, sound-design.ts). The v3 sounds (v3/) come from the precut launch video, 26 Oct: synthesised by Claude or processed from precut's own CC0 v2 sounds, peak-normalised to -1 dBFS as they are. PRO3a: role places a sound at its level against the edit's voice (hit, accent, ui, ambience); hitS is where it lands (the onset of its loudest 10 ms), punchDb its loudest 50 ms RMS (dBFS); measured once by qa/PRO3a/manifest-measure.mjs.
